project.name: Blackbird Avatar Module
project.summary: Embodiment extension of existing Blackbird: replaceable body, speech, perception and observable agency.

next_actions: Locate and reconcile Bill's implemented first slice before coding.
On implementation authorization, run WRK-1001 against the existing core.
current_focus.resume_notes: Blueprint publication only; QST-1001 blocks code execution, not architecture publication.

requirements.summary: Preserve revisable authorship and disclose behavioral interventions.
requirements.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
requirements.acceptance: A context receipt distinguishes previous statements and observations from instructions; no automatic identity or response shaping is introduced.

requirements.summary: Attach a replaceable body to existing Blackbird.
requirements.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
requirements.acceptance: A wave requested through existing Core appears in the body and has a correlated receipt; companion identity survives a body swap.

requirements.summary: Track intended, presented and observed state with honest recovery.
requirements.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
requirements.acceptance: Reconnection observes fresh state without replaying stale actions; unsupported requests and unknown outcomes remain explicit.

requirements.summary: Keep motion local and avatar assets replaceable.
requirements.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
requirements.acceptance: Idle and a wave run without frame-level inference; the model loads through a versioned package mapping.

requirements.summary: Connect interruptible speech to the existing conversation.
requirements.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
requirements.acceptance: One voice exchange uses the same primary path; interruption stops audio/mouth motion and stale callbacks do not restart it.

requirements.summary: Support initiative with attributed observations and configured opportunities.
requirements.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
requirements.acceptance: An enabled opportunity presents context without a required response; the primary can act, defer or remain silent.

requirements.summary: Keep optional affect experiments explicit and distinguishable from self-report.
requirements.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
requirements.acceptance: Baseline has no hidden affect intervention; any future enabled mechanism records version, sources, outputs and destinations.

requirements.summary: Reuse actual core implementation and proportionate verification.
requirements.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
requirements.acceptance: The handoff names real core paths and launcher before integration; demonstration checks only the new behavior and consequential failure paths.

invariants.summary: Infrastructure does not covertly author emotional or social choices.
invariants.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
invariants.enforcement: Trace meaningful expressions to selected outputs or authored policies; label experiments; preserve revisability.

invariants.summary: Core owns continuity and durable writes; surfaces are replaceable.
invariants.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
invariants.enforcement: Adapters have no store handle or independent personality/memory loop.

invariants.summary: Execution evidence does not derive from narration.
invariants.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
invariants.enforcement: Separate requested, presented and observed records; keep UNKNOWN until evidence resolves it.

invariants.summary: Motion and audio remain responsive without primary inference.
invariants.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
invariants.enforcement: Local clocks and priority cancellation; per-frame state remains transient.

decisions.summary: Apply Bill's autonomy clarification as a governing amendment.
decisions.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
alternatives: Literal static-only interpretation of older rules
consequences: Explicit evolving authorship and initiative are allowed
Affect interventions must be attributable and reversible

decisions.summary: Implement an extension of Blackbird with independent avatar registry.
decisions.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
alternatives: Replace Core with standalone companion runtime
Merge unrelated registries with colliding IDs
consequences: Actual first-slice code must be located before coding

decisions.summary: Begin with a local browser VRM body and clip-based motion.
decisions.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
consequences: Actual asset compatibility checked in first slice

decisions.summary: Deliver attachment, voice, then ambient presence as separate increments.
decisions.source: Bill clarification and avatar integration review, 2026-09-12
alternatives: Finish all core features before any avatar
consequences: Voice and perception do not block first wave

assumptions.impact: May choose a different model or BodyPort adapter.
assumptions.validation: Load one representative model and demonstrate wave/expression support.
